Class MoldSensor

java.lang.Object
moldsim.model.MoldSensor
public class MoldSensor extends Object
Sensor responsible for detecting mold levels and generating alert events for walls and shelves in the simulation.

It evaluates infection rates, computes alert levels, and emits events when thresholds are crossed or when sensitive shelves are affected.
